headline: Approved TIF districts for Oxford Street, Cedar Street, and Atlantic Street housing projects, a Brighton Avenue zoning change, and Danielle West's employment contract.
summary: The Council approved several liquor and entertainment license applications, a $45,000 fence restoration grant for Lincoln Park, and asset forfeiture fund transfers to the Police Department. It also approved tax increment financing districts and credit enhancement agreements for affordable housing projects on Oxford Street, Cedar Street, and Atlantic Street, a zoning map change for 1220 Brighton Avenue, and a third amendment to City Manager Danielle P. West's employment agreement.
decisions: Approved Order 1-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Bad Neighbors LLC, dba Bad Neighbors, for a Class XI Restaurant/Lounge at 504 Congress Street, 6-0 with Councilor Fournier recused.
Approved Order 2-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Portland Point Hotel LLC, dba Residence Inn & Moxy Portland Thompson's Point, at 220 Thompson's Point Road, 7-0.
Approved Order 3-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Kieu Tran LLC, dba Pho Viet, for a Class XI Restaurant/Lounge at 865 Forest Avenue, 7-0.
Approved Order 4-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of The Otherside Diner INC, dba The Otherside Diner, at 500 Washington Avenue, 7-0.
Approved Order 5-26/27 granting municipal officers' approval of Foundation Brewing Company at 1 Industrial Way, Ste 5, 7-0.
Approved Order 6-26/27 declaring August 7 to August 9, 2026 the 101st Annual St. Peter's Bazaar and Italian Street Festival, 7-0.
Approved Order 7-26/27 granting an easement to Central Maine Power at Jetport Cross Road, 7-0.
Approved Order 254-25/26 approving a Memorandum of Understanding and accepting and appropriating $45,000 from Friends of Lincoln Park, Inc. for Lincoln Park fence restoration on Federal Street, 7-0.
Approved Order 255-25/26 accepting and appropriating asset forfeiture funds to the Portland Police Department re State of Maine v. Timothy Edward Hansen, 6-1 with Councilor Sykes opposed.
Approved Order 256-25/26 accepting and appropriating asset forfeiture funds to the Portland Police Department re State of Maine v. Justin I. Williams, 6-1 with Councilor Sykes opposed.
Approved Order 257-25/26 accepting and appropriating asset forfeiture funds to the Portland Police Department re State of Maine v. Charles Aboda, 7-1 with Councilor Sykes opposed.

Approved, as amended, Order 258-25/26 designating The Prime 197 Oxford Street Affordable Housing Tax Increment Financing District and adopting its Municipal Development Program, 6-2 with Councilors Sykes and Michniewicz opposed.
Approved Order 259-26/27 approving The Prime 197 Oxford Street Affordable Housing Credit Enhancement Agreement with Avesta Oxford Street LP, 6-2 with Councilors Sykes and Michniewicz opposed.
Approved, as amended, Order 260-25/26 designating the Dashaway Commons 15-19 Cedar Street Affordable Housing Development and Tax Increment Financing District, 7-1 with Councilor Sykes opposed.
Approved Order 261-25/26 approving the Dashaway Commons 15-19 Cedar Street Affordable Housing Credit Enhancement Agreement with Avesta 15-19 Cedar LP, 7-1 with Councilor Sykes opposed.
Approved Order 262-25/26 approving an amendment to the 42 Atlantic Street Affordable Housing Development and Tax Increment Financing District, 8-0.
Approved Order 263-25/26 approving an amendment to the Credit Enhancement Agreement for the 42 Atlantic Street Affordable Housing and Tax Increment Financing District, 8-0.
Approved Order 264-25/26 amending the Portland Zoning Map for a B-4 Zone at 1220 Brighton Avenue and adjacent parcels, 8-0.
Approved Order 8-26/27 approving the Third Amendment to the Employment Agreement between the City of Portland and Danielle P. West, 8-0.
